text: Spirit of Violence is a sha which manifested into the adventurer appearance and is located in Kun-Lai Summit.
Spirit of Anger is a sha which manifested into the adventurer appearance and is located in Kun-Lai Summit.
The Spirit Warden only appears on heroic during the Lich King encounter in Frostmourne in Icecrown Citadel.
Spirit of Hatred is a sha which manifested into a form of Varian Wrynn located in Kun-Lai Summit.

Spirit of Harmony is an extremely rare random world drop from all creatures on Pandaria. It is used in many zen-level profession recipes. As an ingredient, Spirits of Harmony will automatically go in any enchanting bag, herb bag, inscription bag, or leatherworking bag that may be equipped. The main source for Spirits of Harmony is the fairly common world drop Mote of Harmony. Ten of these can be combined into a single Spirit of Harmony. Spirit of Harmony can be used with Alchemy to purchase an extra transmute, Jewelcrafting to purchase extra daily discoveries, and Enchanting to buy reagents.

Lao-Fe the Slavebinder was the last emperor of the mogu empire, killed at the end of the Pandaren Revolution during the battle for Mistfall Province in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. The Spirit of Lao-Fe, along with the spirits of pandaren rebels and his mogu army, haunt the Tu Shen Burial Ground overlooking Mistfall Village to this day.
The Spirit of Lord Alexei Barov is a ghost appearing in Scholomance after defeating Darkmaster Gandling. He is the true form of the Talking Skull.
The Spirit of Tiffin is an Alliance flagship of the 7th Fleet, which docked in Theramore during the events of the Attack on Theramore Isle.
__NOTOC__ Spiritblade Decimator is created with Blacksmithing (565); taught by trainers.
Spiritblade Decimator is created with Blacksmithing (545); taught by trainers.
Spiritbound Brutalizers are mogu located in the Ruins of Ogudei in the Krasarang Wilds.
Spiritbound Arcanists are mogu located in the Ruins of Ogudei in the Krasarang Wilds.
Spirit Traps are crystal mogu artifacts found in the Ruins of Ogudei. They were used by Ogudei's mogu to trap spirits for use in rituals. The Reliquary is interested in these devices.
Spiritbinder Pa'chek is a Zandalari troll located in Za'Tual on the Isle of Thunder.
Spiritbinder Cha'lat is a Zandalari troll located in Za'Tual on the Isle of Thunder.
Spiritbinder Tu'chek is a Zandalari troll located at Conqueror's Terrace on the Isle of Thunder.
Spiritbinder Tec'uat is a Zandalari troll located at Za'Tual on the Isle of Thunder.
Spirit of Warlord Teng is a mogu ghost located Beneath Hall of the Grand Imperion on the Isle of Thunder.

The Spirit Ritual Stone is found at various locations on the Isle of Thunder. Three Shan'ze Ritual Stones can be used to summon one of the summonable bosses required for the Pandaria quest achievements Pay to Slay and It Was Worth Every Ritual Stone. The three spirit champions are: * - Underneath the Hall of the Grand Imperion * - West of Hall of the Defamed * - Ihgaluk Crag beach
__NOTOC__ The Spirit of Atha is a ghostly hydra and part of the three Spirits of Sholazar, which are summoned as part of the daily Oracles quest A Cleansing Song.
The Spirit of Gorat is the ghost of the fallen assassin, Gorat, killed by Captain Elendilad. He aids adventurers in killing the elf.

__NOTOC__ Spirit of Koosu is a spirit taking the form of an ooze that can be summoned and cleanse from the waters of Sholazar Basin.
The Spirit of Jadefire is a rare fire spirit that has a number of static spawn points inside the Cavern of Lost Spirits on Timeless Isle.

Spiritwalker Yona is a tauren shaman part of the Hodir encounter in Ulduar. She, along with her party is trapped in blocks of ice and must be freed to help against the frost titans attacks. If the raid is in the 25man version of Ulduar then she will be replaced by Spiritwalker Tara.

__NOTOC__ Spirit of War is found when disenchanting items from normal and heroic Siege of Orgrimmar. It is used for bypassing the daily cooldowns of the crafting items below.

at the Terrace of Ten Thunders in the Jade Forest.]] The Spiritclaws are a sect of mogu assassin-priests who, at the height of the mogu empire, were the most elite and most feared of the emperor's troops. All have mastered a deathblow which ensnares the spirit of the enemy, trapping it in a jade bottle for delivery to a Spiritbinder. The mogu have continued training Spiritclaws even after the fall of their empire.

Spirus is a wisp that is currently trained by Wise Mari and is present during Celestial Tournament. In order to defeat him, it's suggested to finish him off fast, because of the Soul Ward and the Healing Wave.

The Spirit of Dark Ritualist Zakahn is a tol'vir ghost located within Murkdeep Cavern in Uldum during the Assault in Uldum. He is protected by a Ritual Guardian and an Unliving Ritual Guardian.

The Spirit of Balance is a wolf that attacks Vassandra Stormclaw and Tess Greymane in the Twilight Grove in Duskwood during the Heritage of Gilneas. It is classified as an elemental, but bears the appearance of the adventurer.

Spirit Shades are wisps located near the Dragons of Nightmare.

Spiritual Reflections are mirror images of the players in the party, they are summoned by the Frostsworn General and can be found in the hall between Sword's Rest and the Shadow Throne of the Halls of Reflection.

The Splinter Fist, also known as the Stone Fist Clan, are a group of ogres found in Vul'Gol Ogre Mound. The leader and champion of this group is Zzarc'Vul, whom can be found inside the cave. According to Watcher Dodds, they usually keep to themselves, but they've got a bad habit of attacking travelers. As the Night Watch wanted to only risk its few members in the defense of more immediate threats, they engaged adventurers to kill some of the ogres in exchange for rewards. At some point, Abercrombie was attacked by the ogres, and after they chased him off, they wagered back to their mound and brought his "crate of precious tools and herbs" with them. The necromancer thus sent an Alliance adve
Spitting Scarabs are beetles found in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj.

Splinterspear Junction is where the main road into the Swamp of Sorrows splits. The north branch will take you past the Harborage and to the Fallow Sanctuary, while the southern branch will take you to Stonard and the path to the Blasted Lands. An old orcish watch tower sits there and the area is regularly patrolled by Horde guards, so Alliance adventurers are advised to keep their eyes open when traveling the roads. The guards are PvP tagged.

in the TCG]] Spore walkers, also known as marsh walkers, fen striders, or marshtrekkers, are deadly, towering predators native to the wetlands of Zangarmarsh in Outland as well as fungal swamps on the alternate Draenor. They are ancient enemies of the sporelings. The deadly sporebats are a more highly evolved sub-species of the spore walkers.
Spotted Yellowtail is created with Cooking (225); taught once by Recipe: Spotted Yellowtail, now by trainers.
__NOTOC__ A Splinter of Atiesh is a tiny piece of , which was last wielded by the Last Guardian, Medivh. Once all forty splinters are found, they may be assembled into the Frame of Atiesh.

Splithoof Hold is a cave located in Splithoof Crag in Thousand Needles. The Galak centaur tribe adapted it into a stronghold. The cavern housed the Ancient Brazier and the Sacred Flame, which eternally burns, even underwater. The centaurs, having had to flee the area in order to survive the flooding caused by the Cataclysm, left behind the flame. In the end though, Aquarian doused it.

:The sporelings are a mostly peaceful race of mushroom-men native to Outland. Their home is located in the southern bogs of Zangarmarsh. Sporeggar is a faction of sporelings found along the western edge of Zangarmarsh. The sporelings are native to Outland unfortunately, the changing climate of the marsh has put them in danger. Adventurers that assist their survival will be justly rewarded. The Sporeggar were not always made of mushroom.

Sporelings are a mostly peaceful race of diminutive mushroom-men native to Outland, formerly Draenor. Their capital, Sporeggar, is located in the western bogs of Zangarmarsh. While fearful of travelers (especially those significantly larger than them), the sporelings are quick to welcome anyone to help them. They are beset by many enemies, including the fungal giants, spore walkers, marsh beasts and more recently the naga, leading them to ask for aid from passing adventurers.

The Splinter of Nordrassil is the quest reward for completing the quest The Balance of Light and Shadow (quest), which is the epic priest quest. It is combined with The Eye of Divinity and The Eye of Shadow to form Benediction.
Spraggle Frock is a goblin quest giver located at Marshal's Stand in the Un'Goro Crater. Spraggle Frock is good friends with Ringo. She was previously found at Marshal's Refuge.
Spore-Soaked Vaneer is a cloak that is most often sought after by mages or warlocks.
Spot is a timber wolf found in Theramore in Dustwallow Marsh. He makes a barking sound if you click on him, even if he is tamed by a hunter. Unfortunately, only Horde hunters can tame him.
Springpaw Cubs are lynxes found in the Eversong Woods. Players will often see them following behind Springpaw Lynxes.
Springpaw Lynxes are lynxes found on Sunstrider Isle in the Eversong Woods. Players will often see these mobs being trailed by a Springpaw Cub.
Springpaw Stalkers are lynxes found throughout most of the Eversong Woods.
Sporeling Snack is a consumable item for hunter pets. It increases a pet's Stamina and Spirit by 20 for 30 min.
Sporeling's Firestick is a fast wand that gives fire damage and boosts the wearer's intellect and stamina, making it a desirable wand for fire mages and warlocks.
Splendid Fire Opal is an gem that fits a red or yellow socket.
Venomspitters (or simply spitters and spitting spiders ) are spiders found among other spiders that are capable of spitting their toxins at their prey.
__NOTOC__ Splinter Fist Enslavers are ogres found in Duskwood.
Splinter Fist Fire Weavers are ogre mage pyromancers of the Splinter Fist found in Duskwood.
__NOTOC__ Splinter Fist Ogres are ogres located in Duskwood.
__NOTOC__ Splinter Fist Taskmasters are ogres found in Duskwood.
__NOTOC__ Splinter Fist Warriors are ogres found in Duskwood.
Sporeling Claw is a quest reward from Fhwoor Smash!, received after becoming .
The Sporeggar Tabard is a tabard. It is a representation of trust and friendship amongst the Sporeggar faction.

Sporewing is a named sporebat who flies around the southwest corner of Dead Mire in Zangarmarsh. It occasionally releases a nature-based spore cloud that reduces armor by 15% and does periodic poison damage.
Split Bone Necklace is a quest item only lootable by players on the quest Split Bone Necklace (quest). Kin'weelay of the Darkspear tribe has sent many adventurers to collect these necklaces.
Splintered Logs drop from Wandering Forest Walkers in Feralas.
Sporebat Eyes drop from Spore Bats and Sporewing in Zangarmarsh.
Splintering Battle Axe is a world drop from mobs in the level 42-50 range.
__NOTOC__ Spotted Feltail can be fished in Terokkar Forest, Zangarmarsh, The Underbog and Serpentshrine Cavern.
Splintsteel Armor is a quest reward from Ribbly Screwspigot (quest).
Springpaw Appetizers are sold by in the Farstrider Retreat in Eversong Woods.
Spraggle's Canteen is provided as an objective for: *A Little Help From My Friends *Lost! (quest)
Splitting Hatchet is an one-handed axe with a random enchantment.
Springpaw Pelts drop from Springpaw Stalkers and Elder Springpaws in Eversong Woods.
Springpaw Hide Leggings are a quest reward from Pelt Collection
Springpaw Hide Cloak is a quest reward from Pelt Collection.
Springpaw Appetizers can be picked up off the feast tables of Saltheril's Haven in Eversong Woods when you have Saltheril's Haven Party Invitation on you.

Splintertree Raiders are orcs assisting Torek on his assault on the Silverwing Outpost. When a player talks to Torek a raid will start. And the group will start moving to Silverwing Outpost where they will have to fight various night elves. Thus, they only exist for the quest Torek's Assault.
Sporeggar Preserver are sporelings that guard Sporeggar from hostile creatures.
Sporeggar Harvesters are level 63-64 sporelings found in Sporeggar, Zangarmarsh. They harvest food for the village.
Sporeggar Spawn are tiny sporelings located in the Spawning Glen in Zangarmarsh. They are regularly chased and killed by Starving Bog Lords and Starving Fungal Giants.

Sporelok are sporelings found in Funggor Cavern. They can be seen fighting the Marsh Lurkers and Marsh Dredgers, and heroes of the Alliance and Horde are sent to defeat the giants in Saving the Sporeloks.
Spotted Hippogryphs are hippogryphs found around Howling Fjord.
Spores are large bacterial elementals found in the Twisted Glade of Howling Fjord. They are unable to move and only cast [http://www.wowhead.com/?spell=42526 Spore Cloud] to defend themselves.
Spoiled Reagents can be found in Mage Hunter Personal Effects.
Spotted Hippogryph Down can be found in Howling Fjord and Grizzly Hills.
Sporefish Schools can be found in the various lakes of Zangarmarsh. It contains Zangarian Sporefish.

Splendora is a female villager. She and some villagers were attacked by bandits, however Arthas, Jaina, Falric and some footmen saved her. She gave to Arthas a Potion of Healing as a reward for saving her.

Split Personality is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Grand Magus Telestra in the Nexus on Heroic difficulty after having killed her images within 5 seconds of the first one dying during each split.
Spore Loser (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Loatheb in Naxxramas without killing any spores on 10-player mode.

Spring Flowers are sold by Noblegarden Merchants and Noblegarden Vendors during Noblegarden for and can also be found inside Brightly Colored Eggs. They are used for the achievement Shake Your Bunny-Maker.
The Spring Circlet can be purchased from Noblegarden Merchants and Noblegarden Vendors during Noblegarden for . This item can also be found within Brightly Colored Eggs.

Spring Robes are sold by Noblegarden Merchants and Noblegarden Vendors during Noblegarden for and can rarely be found inside Brightly Colored Eggs. Prior to patch 9.1.5, the robes could be used to plant flowers in five deserts as part of the objective of Desert Rose. The use effect has since been transferred to the Spring Florist's Pouch.
Spring Rabbit's Foot is an item that summons Spring Rabbit, a rabbit companion.
__NOTOC__ Spring Gatherers can be found at the starting areas of the Horde races.

Spring Fling is part of the Noble Gardener meta-achievement for the Noblegarden world event. No PvP action here. Travel to one of the level 4 towns for your faction, break out the Spring Rabbit's Foot, then find another player with their Spring Rabbit out. Once the companions do their thing, head off to the next town. If you let two rabbits who fell in love stay together for a bit, tiny colored eggs will be tossed away from them, announced by the sound effect of getting hit on the head with a Brewfest mug. These land and spawn a Baby Bunny in a burst of flowers. If you want the spawns long enough you will see that the Baby Bunnies come in three different varieties, White, Brown and White wit
Spoggle Greasecakes is a gnome reporter from the Gnomeregan Gnews Gnetwork.
Splinterbone Warriors are skeletal warriors located on the lowest level of the Spiral of Thorns in Razorfen Downs. They are 3rd Rank Splinterbones.
These speedy little skeletons patrol around the Spiral of Thorns. They are very weak, and come in pairs. They are of the lowest Rank of Splinterbones.
Splinterbone Centurions are skeletal warriors found in Razorfen Downs. They are tougher than the Splinterbone Warriors. They are 2nd Rank Splinterbones.
Splinterbone Captains are the elite of Amnennar's Splinterbone unit in Razorfen Downs.

The Splinterbone skeletons are a unit of skeletal warriors and skeletal mages that operate in the Razorfen Downs, serving Amnennar the Coldbringer by guarding and patrolling the Spiral of Thorns. Mordresh Fire Eye is in charge of maintaining their morale, giving speeches at the Bone Pile.
The Spool of Thread can be found in the first room to the left as you enter the Sanctum of Reanimation in Icecrown.
Wearing a Spring Tuxedo meets half the requirement for Blushing Bride. The other player character needs to be wearing an Elegant Dress.
Spitzpatrick's Bomber is made by Crusade Engineer Spitzpatrick. It is located in Valley of Echoes in Icecrown.
Split Hoof is vendor trash which drops from some hooved animals in Northrend.
The Spoils of War Set is the second set of the World of Warcraft Miniatures Game. It consists of 51 figures and 70 cards. The set was released May 5, 2009.
Spring Collectors can be found at the starting areas of the Alliance races.
Spotted Swellfishs are puffer fish located in and near the Ruins of Vashj'ir in Shimmering Expanse.
Spoils of the Courtyard are a quest reward from Re-Take the Courtyard.
Spotter Klemmy is dwarf located at a small camp in Dun Morogh. He sometimes gets hit by a mortar when Shorty and Angus practice their aim.
Splintertree Guards are orcs who guard Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. The max-level version appears when Alliance approach the area.

Splithoof Heights is the Galak centaur village, on the large shelf to the north of the Shimmering Deep in Thousand Needles. It's here that the Galak retreated to from Splithoof Hold, Splithoof Crag, and Camp E'thok to survive the flooding caused by the Cataclysm. The land contains many oil pools and likely has a huge pocket of oil under them. Both the goblins and gnomes and trying to make the centaur a deal in order to gain the drilling rights to the oil. The centaur here worship an air elemental and a lord within the Skywall, named Whrrrl, who has become the supposed leader of the tribe.
Spools of Rope are found on the floor of a gunship or looted from Coil of Rope in Deepholm.
Splinterproof Bracers is a quest reward from A Strange Disc.

Spitters are large carnivorous plants capable of spitting poisons first introduced in World of Warcraft: Cataclysm and are classified as elementals in-game. The fruits of the Wailing Weed corrupted by the demon Tyrus Blackhorn's demonic essence are called Bileberry and have a pus-like ichor bursting from its leathery skin.

This weapon sues steam pressure to fire hundreds of thorn-sized wooden darts in a single shot. Ammunition for the splinter gun can be created by feeding small pieces of wood into a grinder built into its stock. Many of those who wield splinter guns can be recognized by the "tinder pouches" hanging from their belts.
The Splintered Path is a hastily made path though the Thunderwood between Nectarbreeze Orchard and Camp Gormal in the Jade Forest. The mogu that created the path use it to kidnap the farmers.
The Spring Road leads from the Tavern in the Mists to the Ancient Passage on the Veiled Stair.
The Ashenvale Demolisher is a demolisher bombarding the attacking night elves at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. It is operated by Draaka.
The Splintertree Overseers are orcs overseeing the work of the peons within the Splintertree Mine in Splintertree Post in Ashenvale.
.]] The Splintertree Mine is a mine located in the back of Splintertree Post. It is being mined by Splintertree Peons overseen by Splintertree Overseers.

The Ashenvale Peons are orcs digging within the Splintertree Mine in Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. Their work is being overseen by Splintertree Overseers. During the quest Rain of Destruction, they can be seen cowering in fear due to the night elf attack.
__NOTOC__ Splitclaw Skitterers are crabs found in Legion's Fate and Seafarer's Tomb in Kelp'thar Forest.
Sprig of Dreamleaf is found on a Dreamleaf Bush at the upper level of the Pools of Purity in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Splintered Skeletons are skeletons found in the Vault of the Ravenian in Scholomance.
__NOTOC__ Sporeling Sprouts are sporelings located in Zangarmarsh.

Spoils of Theramore was rewarded from the scenario Theramore's Fall before Mists of Pandaria. Note that the Theramore Tabard and the Mini Mana Bomb are not contained in the loot bag, but were instead mailed directly to players upon their first completion of the scenario, but only for the level 85 one week event.
Spring Blossom Sapling are purchased from for and can be planted at Sunsong Ranch to grow Spring Blossom Tree. Can also be looted from Tree Seed Pack. Requires Revered with the Tillers.
The Spring Blossom Tree is grown from an Spring Blossom Sapling at the Sunsong Ranch.
Spriggin is a level 87 rare hozen that appears on the isle of Unga Ingoo in Krasarang Wilds. He is a Pandarian champion.
Spotted Caterpillars are found on and around trees throughout Townlong Steppes.
Spotted Swarmer is a level 90 silkworm located at Old Pi'jiu of Timeless Isle.
Spreading the Warmth is a quest achievement earned for killing 60 Krik'thik Hivelings with a single Shado-Pan torch. Players obtain this achievement while completing Mantid Under Fire.
__NOTOC__ Splorg is an ogre located at the Circle of Blood in Frostfire Ridge.
Sporebat Darters are sporebats found in the Amphitheater of Annihilation in Ashran.
Spray-O-Matic 5000 XT is found at in the forward half of the hull of the Wreck of the Mother Load in southeastern Spires of Arak.
Spore Drifters are spore bats located in the Sporemist Shallows in the Spires of Arak.
Spore Hulks were fungal giants located at Pinchwhistle Point in the Spires of Arak. They were replaced by Spore Shamblers.
Spore Shamblers are fungal monsters found on the southernmost point of . They wander the area around Jiasska the Sporegorger, and Mutafen at the coast of The South Sea in the Spires of Arak.
Splinters of Hate were never made available. Combining 10 of them would form an Essence of Hatred.
Springrain is an item level 483 druid item set. It is inspired by Wildheart Raiment, the druid version of Dungeon Set 1, though it is not a mere recolor.
Spooky Supplies are a Draenor-specific Hallow's End currency. Five can be acquired each daily reset period. Use them to purchase garrison decorations.
Splitgrin the Massacre is an orc located at the Broken Horn Village in Gorgrond.
Spooky Pepe is a Pepe bird with a Scarecrow outfit on found in Lunarfall and Frostwall .

Sporemist Shallows are located just south-east of Pinchwhistle Gearworks in the Spires of Arak. The shallows are infested with various mushrooms. Spore Pustules are found throughout the area. Spore-be-Gone Turrets have been placed to deal with the problem, but have since gone inactive, and are now ironically covered in Coastal Spores. Rejuvenating Mycena can be found here, offering restorative qualities. A small ship is located just off the coast, with a set of Payment Delivery Instructions found aboard.
Sploder's Head drops from Chief Bombgineer Sploder at Silverwind Refuge in Ashenvale.
Spring Blossoms is a Restoration druid talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Overgrowth (druid talent).
Spoiled Azsharan Wineskins are a world drop from chests in the Broken Isles.
Spitfire Hellions are felbats that appears at the Legion Invasion locations.
Spray and Pray was a Marksmanship hunter honor talent, available at rank 28.
Sploosh is a murloc located at the Winterfin Retreat in the Borean Tundra.
Splishy is a murloc located at the Winterfin Retreat in the Borean Tundra.

The Spring Balloon Festival is a micro-holiday event that takes place around Azeroth and alternate Draenor. Balloon pilots travel around the world to bring their balloons to various places. Any denizen of Azeroth can find them on their map and should they visit them, they will be taken for a ride.
Spitespeaker Lir'kess is a naga located in the Hatecoil Warcamp in Azsuna.
The Spoiled Sample could be looted from the Challenger's Bounty and emissary containers.
Splinterbone Shadowcasters are skeletons located in Razorfen Downs.
Spitescale Wavethrashers are naga located on the Echo Isles.
Splintered Talbuk Bone Sickle is looted from chests on Argus.
Spoils of the Legion's Fall is a lootable necklace located at Azsuna in the Tomb of Sargeras. It appears after Kil'jaeden is defeated.
Splintered Thralls are wicker men located in a cellar at Arom's Stand in Drustvar. They are disguised as Arom's Stand Commoners.
Splinterbone Frostweavers are skeletons located in Razorfen Downs.
Sporonite Bombs are looted from Truffles in Stormsong Valley.
The Spitescale Stompers are a quest reward from An Ancient Enemy.
The Spooky Incantation is looted from the Bespelled Chest in Drustvar.

The Splitter of the Horde Vanguard is a quest reward from The Battle for Broken Shore (Horde).
